(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative of BH4, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative of BH4, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative of BH4, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide, and saralasin, wherein each of the compounds listed is described in the specification as having the function to inhibit the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components, wherein component (I) comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative of BH4, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, and component (II) comprises an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a known pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof.
